statement: An entity carrying on an enterprise in Australia is entitled to an Australian Business Number, a Corporations Act company is entitled to an ABN, and to get an ABN the entity applies to the Registrar for registration in the Australian Business Register.
caveat: Limited registration entities under the GST Act are not entitled to an ABN. The ABN application can be combined with tax registrations (GST, PAYG withholding) and, through the Business Registration Service, with the company registration itself.
